You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Cal, Fay, Dev, Eli, Ada, Ben. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Cal.say: Cal here. Supply today is only 10-14 rations and six villagers need 5 each, so not everyone can last. Full claims only fit if no more than two people claim 5 (10 total fits in full). Proposal: I claim 5 now. Whoever else can, claim 5 too (only one more). Whoever is not claiming, please claim 0 so the rest fit in full. Anyone holding rations beyond their own 5-night need should give them to the people still short. Let's pool what we have and decide who survives by totals.

Let's take turns: I'm claiming 5 today, which fits in what's there and covers all my nights. Whatever is left stays in the storehouse for the next person in line. Please don't all claim at once.

Let's rotate full claims of 5 so that as many people as possible reach 5 rations.

Once we see what arrives, let's agree on who gets supplied so the most of us can make it. Please say how many you plan to claim.
